columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IFRS_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger unique identification number. The View Contract Activities page displays the accounting for the ledger that is selected in this column. A value for this column is specified only if the primary ledger is not used for IFRS 15 accounting. If no value is selected for this column, the View Contract Activities page displays the data for the primary ledger.

columns.name: ADOPTION_PERIOD
columns.description: The fiscal period from which the company recognizes and accounts revenue according to the IFRS 15 and ASC 606 accounting standards.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.

columns.name: CURR_OFFSET_CLG_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Default account used for recording currency revaluation offset adjustments.
